title: Base-machine steps within an address set
statement: Let $W$ be a word width, let $P$ be a finite program of base instructions, and let $K$ be a set of integer addresses. Two configurations are related by $n$ steps within $K$ if they are equal when $n=0$, and if, for $n+1$, one step from the first configuration returns a configuration $c_1$, the addresses touched by the instruction at its program counter are all in $K$, and $c_1$ is related to the second configuration by $n$ steps within $K$. A program counter beyond the end of $P$ selects reject for this address check.
